subject.raw_text: ATA 36 – Pneumatic – Duct Assembly Material – Replacement

applicability_groups.label: A380 applicability stated in the AD
applicability_groups.raw_text: Applicability: Airbus A380-841, A380-842 and A380-861 aeroplanes, all manufacturer serial numbers.

applicability_groups.label: A380 replacement applicability excluding production modification 66360
applicability_groups.raw_text: All aeroplanes, except those modified in accordance with Airbus modification 66360.
exclusions: Aeroplanes modified in accordance with Airbus modification 66360

unsafe_condition.raw_reason_text: Reason: During type certification pressure-endurance testing of the pneumatic duct system, two pneumatic ducts failed because of fatigue cracking before completion of the endurance test. If not corrected, this could lead to leakage or exceedance of a temperature limit in the inboard outer fixed leading-edge area of the wing and, combined with inability to isolate the affected section from hot-air supply, possibly reduce wing structural integrity. Airbus developed improved parts introduced by modification 66360 and issued SB A380-36-8016 for in-service modification. This AD requires replacement of affected parts with serviceable parts.
observed_events_or_defects: During type certification activities, involving pressure endurance test of the pneumatic duct system, failure of two pneumatic ducts was experienced.
causes: Fatigue cracking of pneumatic ducts before completion of the pressure-endurance test.
unsafe_conditions: Leakage or temperature-limit exceedance in the inboard outer fixed leading-edge area, combined with inability to isolate the affected section from hot-air supply.
potential_consequences: Reduced structural integrity of the wing.
affected_components: Pneumatic duct assemblies in the inboard outer fixed leading-edge area
Affected duct assemblies P/N L3615003000000/100 and L3615003100000/100
intended_risk_mitigation: Replace affected duct assemblies with the improved serviceable assemblies introduced by Airbus modification 66360.

requirements.action_text: (1) Within 25 months after the effective date of this AD, replace affected duct assembly P/N L3615003000000/100 with P/N L3615023700000/100, and affected duct assembly P/N L3615003100000/100 with P/N L3615023800000/100, in accordance with Airbus SB A380-36-8016.

compliance_rules.raw_text: (1) Within 25 months after the effective date of this AD, replace affected duct assembly P/N L3615003000000/100 with P/N L3615023700000/100, and affected duct assembly P/N L3615003100000/100 with P/N L3615023800000/100, in accordance with Airbus SB A380-36-8016.
conditions: Aeroplane is not modified in accordance with Airbus modification 66360

requirements.action_text: (2.1) For an aeroplane that has an affected duct assembly installed on the effective date of this AD, after completing the replacement required by paragraph (1), do not install an affected duct assembly P/N listed in Table 1.
objects_or_components: Affected duct assembly P/N L3615003000000/100 or L3615003100000/100
conditions: Affected duct assembly was installed on the effective date of this AD

conditions: Affected duct assembly was installed on the effective date

objects_or_components: Affected duct assembly P/N L3615003000000/100 or L3615003100000/100
conditions: No affected duct assembly was installed on the effective date of this AD

evidence_spans.exact_quote: EASA AD No.: 2016-0175 Airworthiness Directive AD No.: 2016-0175 Issued: 31 August 2016 Note: This Airworthiness Directive (AD) is issued by EASA, acting in accordance with Regulation (EC) 216/2008 on behalf of the European Union, its Member States and of the European third countries that participate in the activities of EASA under Article 66 of that Regulation. This AD is issued in accordance with Regulation (EU) 748/2012, Part 21.A.3B. In accordance with Regulation (EU) 1321/2014 Annex I, Part M.A.301, the continuing airworthiness of an aircraft shall be ensured by accomplishing any applicable ADs. Consequently, no person may operate an aircraft to which an AD applies, except in accordance with the requirements of that AD, unless otherwise specified by the Agency [Regulation (EU) 1321/2014 Annex I, Part M.A.303] or agreed with the Authority of the State of Registry [Regulation (EC) 216/2008, Article 14(4) exemption]. Design Approval Holder’s Name: Type/Model designation(s): AIRBUS A380 aeroplanes Effective Date: 14 September 2016 TCDS Number(s): EASA.A.110 Foreign AD: Not applicable Supersedure: None ATA 36 – Pneumatic – Duct Assembly Material – Replacement Manufacturer(s): Airbus Applicability: Airbus A380-841, A380-842 and A380-861 aeroplanes, all manufacturer serial numbers. Reason: During type certification activities, involving pressure endurance test of the pneumatic duct system, failure of two pneumatic ducts was experienced. The failures occurred due to fatigue cracking before the completion of the endurance test. This condition, if not corrected, could lead to a leakage or exceedance of a temperature limit in the area of the inboard outer fixed leading edge of the wing and, combined with an inability to isolate the affected section from hot air supply, could possibly result in reduced structural integrity of the wing. To address this potential unsafe condition, Airbus developed improved parts, introduced by Airbus modification (mod) 66360 on the production line, and published Service Bulletin (SB) A380-36-8016 to provide modification instructions for in-service aeroplanes. Required Action(s) and Compliance Time(s): Required as indicated, unless accomplished previously: All aeroplanes, except those modified in accordance with Airbus mod 66360: (1) Within 25 months after the effective date of this AD, replace the duct assembly identified as ‘Affected Part Number (P/N)’ in Table 1 of this AD with a serviceable part identified as ‘Acceptable Replacement P/N‘ in Table 1 of this AD in accordance with the instructions of Airbus SB A380-36-8016. (2.2) For an aeroplane that, on the effective date of this AD, does not have a duct assembly, having a P/N identified as ‘Affected P/N’ in Table 1 of this AD installed: From the effective date of this AD.
